notes.title: Good Mourning content update 3
notes.notes:
Hello crew! This content update marks the first milestone for the end of Early Access. Majority of the planned content is now added to the game, as this update introduces the second ending of the game. The update also includes several fixed typos, a few squished bugs, and a set of new music tracks.
Have fun exploring the new content! We're waiting to see who is the first to uncover the alternate ending of the game!

notes.title: Good Mourning Content Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's almost Christmas, so here's the second content update for you! There are five new scenes and a bunch of other smaller additions. Once again, have fun exploring the expansion!
The next content update will be released late February. We've laid the foundation for a larger content update, which we want to serve you as ready as possible.
Have a great christmas y'all!

[b]Patch notes[/b]
[list]
[*]added five new scenes
[*]added several npc characters
[*]fixed three critical bugs that prevent completing the game
[*]fixed several typos
[/list]

notes.title: Good Mourning content patch 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First set of additional content is here. We have added 5 new scenes in the beginning of the game, have fun exploring the expansion.
